name: Email preview builds itself beside the chat
looks: Beside the chat panel, a live email layout fills in step with each exchange: the generated photo slots into the top of the email, the brand's logo appears painted directly onto the product packaging in the photo, then a headline, a paragraph of body copy and a coloured CTA button settle into place below it. The camera pulls back slightly at the end to show the whole composed email at once.
build: Fixed two-panel split, chat left, email preview right. Each chat reply cues exactly one preview change: image cross-fade into its slot, logo blended onto the product via a soft multiply layer, headline and paragraph revealed by a widening clip-path, CTA button fading in last. Final pull-back is `scale 1.04 -> 1` over 400ms once the chat goes quiet.
sound: A soft low pad under the chat, a light chime on each piece of the email landing, quiet under the final held pull-back.
prompt: Beside a chat panel, let a document preview assemble itself one piece at a time, each change landing on the beat of the exchange that asked for it: an image settling into place, a brand mark blending onto it, then a headline, body copy and a CTA button arriving in turn with no cursor or click anywhere. Finish by pulling the camera back slightly to reveal the whole composed piece.
